programs.title: Road absurdities
programs.desc: In the program "Road Absurdities", Kamil Jaśkowski and Krzysiek Ruszała follow the trail of stupidity and lack of imagination of road workers and officials.The program's hosts go to Poland in a prototype siren with the symbol S201 to take a closer look at examples of incompetence.These include poorly placed signs, streetlights placed in the middle of the road and other places that make life difficult for drivers.The "Road Absurdities" series is an overview of places characterized by careless construction.Mostly, they are behind huge amounts of money spent lightly by officials.Non-functional communication infrastructure facilities are located both on highways, local roads and city streets.The presenters do not stop at showing them in front of the camera, but often intervene in offices, construction contractors and road managers.
